IntentionBench
	


	
		
		Dataset Introduction
	

IntentionBench is a dataset created to test and train how well an AI can detect moments when a user goes "off-task" while performing a computer operation.
It was built to validate the distraction detection performance of INA (Intent Assistant) in the paper “State Your Intention to Steer Your Attention: An AI Assistant for Intentional Digital Living”.

reputation: A small, research-focused dataset used in HCI and attention-steering studies to validate distraction/off-task detection methods; limited broader adoption.
